title: 第五章招收小弟第六章会逃跑的骷髅战士
content_zh:
第五章招收小弟今天三更，求点击，推荐，咖啡！
在亡灵界，所有的亡灵都是依靠灵魂碎片或是残破的灵魂形成的，灵魂是所有亡灵生物的根本。所以在亡灵界只要你的灵魂之力足够强大，你就可以站在亡灵界的最顶端。
但是并不是所有的亡灵都是依靠灵魂强大才强大的，在亡灵界有这么几个特例：首先就是亡灵界最顶端的生物――骨龙。
骨龙，顾名思义就是巨龙死后，变成的亡灵生物。它们靠异常坚硬的巨龙尸骨，还有死后残留的龙族血脉以及龙威，成为亡灵界不折不扣的王者！计算是实力最差的骨龙也会有九阶的实力，实力强大的更是能达到传说的圣阶。
像是骷髅战士、骷髅法师、亡灵法师、僵尸、木乃伊、亡灵骑士等，这些普通的亡灵都是根据自身的灵魂强度而又的实力，只是它们同类之间阶位差距很大。
而另一类的特例就是骨魔：骨魔它是亡灵界自身法则的一种特殊产物，他并不是一个生物死后的亡灵。它是由亡灵界一些游离的灵魂碎片组成了灵魂，再由很浓郁的死亡能量下产生的一种特殊生物。
骨魔本身的灵魂之力并不强大，但是它却能控制强大的能量。骨魔一产生最少会有六阶高级的实力，它们不会像其它亡灵生物一样会随着实力的提升而产生智慧，它根本没有任何智力可言，在它们眼中只有厮杀，并且对所有的能量来之不拒……
正因为这样，骨魔是所有有智慧的亡灵生物最不愿碰到的，骨魔不会因为你的实力比它强而会退缩，它们只会不停地战斗要么战死，要么变的更强。
和骨魔相比，亡灵法师就是另一个极端。它们就是依靠这自己的灵魂之力的强大而强大。对于亡灵法师躯体就并不重要了，因为它们的实力取决于自身的灵魂强度。
它们依靠着自己的强大的灵魂之力，能使用亡灵法术和灵魂契约召唤小弟，实力大都在四阶初级以上。
现在的陈林可以说是新的一个特例。因为有神魂决和禁魂咒的存在，使得陈林从一个最低级的亡灵生物幽灵成长为现在的三阶高级实力的骷髅战士，而且同时拥有了超强的灵魂之力。
陈林现在既是一个骷髅战士也可以说是一个亡灵法师，只是他还没有什么像样的攻击法术，只有一个符咒契约算是法术了。不过陈林以后的成长是无可限量的！
而陈林现在也只能利用，自己现在唯一个法术灵魂契约，开始了自己征服亡灵界的第一步――招收小弟。
因为自己所在的区域是亡灵界的低级亡灵区域，所以能量很是匮乏没几个实力像样的亡灵。在经过一番挑选后，找到三个三阶初级和九个二阶巅峰的骷髅战士。至于二阶高级的亡灵~算了吧！它们根本没有能力自保，更别说跟自己闯荡了！
当然挑选了并不代表它们就会跟着自己当小弟！所以在选定好目标后接下来就是最后的阶段――收服小弟！只见陈林浑身的王霸之气一现，所有被选中的骷髅小弟纷纷拜倒在他的脚下！当然这只是陈林自己yy的。现实的情况是这些准小弟们根本不领他的情！
因为陈林现在没有道符可以施展禁魂咒，所以陈林必须在对方完全没有反抗的情况下收服。第一位小弟，在陈林百般威bi利诱下依然宁死不屈，最后只能被超度了……
“出师不利啊，看来不用绝招不行了”，于是陈林走向了下一个准小弟！
在一番教导之后这名准小弟还是不给面子，没办法只能使出自己的绝招。于是陈林施展出自己凡魂阶初级的灵魂之力，灵魂的威压全部压向了它……
这名小弟本能的缩到一边，在陈林强大的灵魂之力的威胁下终于放弃了反抗！陈林趁机施展了符咒契约，第二次施展禁魂咒竟然成功了！于是陈林有了第一个小弟……
“看来这年头收小弟不能以德服人，必须坑蒙拐骗外带吓唬一起用才行啊！”陈林这样‘恶毒’的想着。

在接下来的几个小弟还算幸运，除了两个小骷髅因为宁死不屈被灭了以外其它的都成功的‘收服了’！就这样陈林在一番努力后有了九名小弟。
于是陈林带着这九名小弟浩浩荡荡的，向着更高级的亡灵区域方向进发，很有点扛把子的感觉就差吼上一句“走着，兄弟们跟着大哥找场子去……”
一路上陈林带着自已的一群小弟们，穿过了好几个和自己呆过的低级区域一样的区域，大大小小的仗经历了好几百场。一路上直接横扫过去。而随着自己不断的战斗自己的手下，也在不断的改变着……
陈林回想起自己这一段时间的经历，自己很有点以战养战的感觉。从自己出发到现在自己的手下不知道换过多少次了。自己最早收服的手下更是只剩下二个，不过它们的实力却都有提升，现在都是三阶高级级的实力。
而陈林自己则因为有神魂决这样逆天的修炼功法，已经达到了四阶中级的水平了，成功的成为了一名中级亡灵！并且还学会了几个很实用的法术，可以说现在的陈林是一个不折不扣的魔武双修的骷髅。
而自己手下也有二十几个，这都些小弟大都是经过好几次战斗洗礼的精英。三阶高级的就有九个，其余的也多数在三阶初级的水平以上，只有少数几个‘新人’还是二阶巅峰的水平。
其实以现在陈林的灵魂强度，陈林是还可以继续用禁魂咒收服小弟的，但是一次战斗的失败让陈林知道‘兵’贵精不贵多！这一次失败也是这次闯荡唯一一次失败：
那一次的对手是一位四阶高级的亡灵法师，只带了十几只骷髅战士在身边。而陈林那时虽然才三阶巅峰，但是却有着一百五十多个小弟，看到这种情况陈林当然是上去群殴了……
可是战斗的结果却是却让陈林自己傻了眼，自己平时最拿手的骷髅海战术没起到一点的作用，反而被对方用法术打得落花流水，差点连自己都挂了。
因为骷髅法师的那几个小弟大都是四阶中级和高级的实力。而自己这里最强的手下才是三阶中级，根本没办法冲破它们的防线，结果就是自己的队伍被亡灵法师轰杀殆尽……
在上次战斗后陈林就开始了自己的‘精兵’路线。在经过了几十次战斗后，自己为数不多的手下实力都得到了很高的提升。并在自己的带领下灭了那个四阶的骷髅法师，而陈林自己也因此到达了四阶的水平，并且在吸收它的灵魂的时候学到了第一个法术，很实用的攻击法术--骨刺。
回忆过后，陈林有一次带领着自己的手下继续闯荡，向着更高级的区域进发。陈林带着队伍来到了一个新的区域，在一番战斗后终于占领了一块属于自己的地方！
而就在陈林打算清理低级的骷髅的时候，突然看到不远出一个二阶初级的骷髅战士，向自己这边跑了过来……
本来一个二阶骷髅没有什么问题，但是会逃跑的却没有很稀奇！而且它后面那一群骷髅是怎么回事！而且还有达到了五阶初级的亡灵，如果要是和它们正面冲突肯定会损失惨重的。
就在陈林考虑要怎么应对的时候，那个小骷髅也发现了陈林，小骷髅看到陈林后一愣，对没看错就是一愣，很有人性话的一愣。陈林把这个小骷髅的行为看的一清二楚……
“看来是这次非正面冲突不可了，不过为了这个小骷髅值得了。”

Chapter 5: Recruiting a younger brother. Three updates today. Please click, recommend, and have coffee!
In the world of the undead, all undead are formed from soul fragments or broken souls. The soul is the foundation of all undead creatures. So in the world of the undead, as long as your soul power is strong enough, you can stand at the top of the world of the undead.
But not all undead are powerful because of their strong souls. There are several special cases in the undead world: The first is the top creature in the undead world-the bone dragon.
Bone dragon, as its name suggests, is the undead creature that the dragon turns into after it dies. They rely on the extremely hard dragon bones, as well as the dragon blood and dragon power that remain after death, to become the out-and-out kings of the undead world! The calculation is that the weakest bone dragon will have the strength of the ninth level, and the powerful ones can even reach the legendary holy level.
Such as skeleton warriors, skeleton mages, necromancers, zombies, mummies, undead knights, etc. These ordinary undead are all based on their own soul strength and strength, but there is a big gap between their ranks.
Another special case is the bone demon: the bone demon is a special product of the laws of the undead world. He is not the undead after the death of a living creature. It is a special creature that is composed of some free soul fragments from the undead world and is produced by very strong death energy.
The bone demon's own soul power is not powerful, but it can control powerful energy. Bone demons will have at least six levels of advanced strength when they are born. They will not develop wisdom as their strength increases like other undead creatures. They have no intelligence at all. In their eyes, they can only fight, and they will not refuse all energy...
Because of this, the Bone Demon is the last thing any intelligent undead creature wants to encounter. The Bone Demon will not shrink back just because you are stronger than it. They will just keep fighting and either die or become stronger.
Compared with the Bone Demon, the Necromancer is the other extreme. They rely on the power of their own souls to become powerful and powerful. For Necromancers, the body is not important, because their strength depends on the strength of their own souls.
Relying on their own powerful soul power, they can use necromancy spells and soul contracts to summon their younger brothers, and their strength is mostly at the fourth level or above.
Chen Lin now can be said to be a new special case. Because of the existence of the Divine Soul Art and the Soul-forbidden Curse, Chen Lin has grown from the lowest level undead creature ghost to the current third-level skeleton warrior with advanced strength, and at the same time possesses super powerful soul power.
Chen Lin is now both a skeleton warrior and a necromancer, but he doesn't have any decent attack spells yet. He only has a spell contract as a spell. But Chen Lin’s future growth is limitless!
Now Chen Lin can only use his only magic soul contract to start his first step in conquering the world of the undead - recruiting a younger brother.
Because the area he is in is a low-level undead area in the undead world, there is very little energy and there are not many undead with decent strength. After some selection, three third-level elementary and nine second-level peak skeleton warriors were found. As for the second-level high-level undead~forget it! They have no ability to protect themselves, let alone fight against themselves!
Of course, choosing one doesn’t mean they will follow you and become your little brothers! So after choosing the target, the next step is the final stage-conquering the younger brother! Chen Lin's domineering aura suddenly appeared, and all the selected skeleton boys fell at his feet! Of course, this is just Chen Lin’s personal opinion. The reality is that these young men-to-be don’t appreciate his kindness at all!
Because Chen Lin now has no Taoist talisman to cast the soul-forbidden spell, Chen Lin must subdue the opponent without any resistance at all. The first younger brother, despite Chen Lin's various threats and inducements, still preferred to die and refused to give in. In the end, he could only be saved...
"It’s a bad start, it seems I can’t do it without using a special move.” So Chen Lin walked towards the next would-be younger brother!
After some teachings, the young man-to-be still refused to give face, so he had no choice but to resort to his own tricks. So Chen Lin exerted his soul power at the elementary level of mortal soul, and all the pressure of the soul pressed against it...
The young man instinctively shrank aside, and finally gave up resistance under the threat of Chen Lin's powerful soul power! Chen Lin took the opportunity to cast the spell contract, and the second time he cast the soul-forbidden spell, he succeeded! So Chen Lin had his first younger brother...
"It seems that these days, you can't convince people with virtue when you recruit a younger brother. You have to use deceit, kidnapping, and intimidation together!" "Chen Lin thought viciously.
The next few guys were lucky, except for the two little skeletons who were killed because they would rather die than surrender, the others were successfully 'conquered'! In this way, Chen Lin had nine younger brothers after a lot of hard work.
So Chen Lin led these nine younger brothers towards the higher-level undead area. He almost shouted, "Let's go, brothers, follow the big brother to find a place..."
Along the way, Chen Lin took his group of younger brothers through several areas similar to the low-level areas he had stayed in, and experienced hundreds of battles, large and small. Straight across the road. And as he continues to fight, his subordinates are also constantly changing...
Chen Lin recalled his experience during this period, and he felt a bit like fighting to support fighting. I don’t know how many times I have changed my subordinates since I started. There are only two of his earliest subordinates left, but their strength has improved, and now they are all at the third level of advanced level.
And Chen Lin himself has reached the fourth-level intermediate level because of his heaven-defying cultivation skills such as the Divine Soul Art, and successfully became an intermediate undead! He also learned several very practical spells. It can be said that Chen Lin is now an out-and-out skeleton of both magic and martial arts.
And he has more than twenty men under him, most of whom are elites who have been baptized by many battles. There are nine third-level advanced ones, and most of the rest are above the third-level beginner level. Only a few 'newcomers' are still at the second-level peak level.
In fact, with Chen Lin's current soul strength, Chen Lin can still use the soul-forbidden curse to subdue his younger brother, but the failure of a battle made Chen Lin know that soldiers are more valuable than their essence! This failure was also the only failure in this adventure:
The opponent that time was a fourth-level advanced necromancer who only brought a dozen skeleton warriors with him. Although Chen Lin was only at the peak of the third level at that time, he had more than 150 younger brothers. Seeing this, of course Chen Lin went up and started a group fight...
However, the result of the battle made Chen Lin dumbfounded. His usually best Skeleton Sea tactic had no effect at all. Instead, he was beaten to a pulp by the opponent's spells, and he almost died.
Because most of the Skeleton Mage's younger brothers have fourth-level intermediate and advanced abilities. And his strongest subordinates here are the third-level intermediates, and there is no way to break through their defenses. As a result, his team was killed by the necromancer...
After the last battle, Chen Lin started his own "elite soldier" route. After dozens of battles, the strength of his few men has been greatly improved. And under his own leadership, he destroyed the fourth-level skeleton mage, and Chen Lin himself reached the fourth-level level as a result, and learned the first spell when absorbing its soul, a very practical attack spell-bone spur.
After reminiscing, Chen Lin once led his men to continue their adventure and move towards a more advanced area. Chen Lin led the team to a new area and finally occupied a place of his own after a battle!
And just nowWhen Chen Lin was about to clean up the low-level skeletons, he suddenly saw a second-level elementary skeleton warrior coming out not far away and running towards him...
Originally, there was nothing wrong with a second-level skeleton, but it was not unusual for one to run away! And what’s going on with the group of skeletons behind it! There are also undead that have reached the fifth level. If you have a head-on conflict with them, you will definitely suffer heavy losses.
Just when Chen Lin was thinking about how to deal with it, the little skeleton also discovered Chen Lin. When the little skeleton saw Chen Lin, he was stunned. I was right, he was stunned. It was a very humane expression. Chen Lin saw clearly what this little skeleton was doing...
"It seems that this time we have to face a head-on conflict, but it's worth it for this little skeleton."
